_source: Roles and modules from the product doc 'Sutra roles and module access'. Loaded into the database at start-up; edit here, not in code.

roles.name: Team member
roles.description: Sysadmin, developer or network engineer who owns assets

roles.name: Team manager
roles.description: Manager of one or more owning teams

roles.name: Vertical head
roles.description: Head of Corporate IT, a plant or a business unit

roles.name: Plant engineer
roles.description: OT or maintenance engineer at a plant

roles.name: Compliance officer
roles.description: CEA or ISO owner, often in the CISO office

roles.name: Auditor
roles.description: External CERT-In empanelled auditor; the account must have an expiry date

roles.name: Admin
roles.description: Customer's platform owner; no approvals and no risk data unless given another role

_notes.M-ADM act: CISO's 'approval thresholds (act)' from the doc: M-ADM act allows editing approval thresholds only; M-ADM admin covers users, roles, grants, licences and the ownership chart.
_notes.M-PJ approve (CISO): The doc's 'final sign-off on risk acceptance for Act'. The CISO can sign only the CISO step of a risk acceptance (sutra.app.jobs.can_sign); patch-job steps stay with the manager, VM analyst and vertical head.
_notes.OEM / vendor: V3 role from the doc; not in the catalogue until the Third-party access module exists.
